messages:
Marta: Heads-up — planning to flip the model-serving feature toggle for release/2026-03-20 during the 15:00–16:00 change window. Staged plan: 2% -> 25% -> 100% with 30min observation between stages. Will pin model_v1 to cohort 'legacy-pin' during rollout so canaries stay stable. Any objections? :eyes:
Jin: +1. Can we add a quick health check to abort on 503 spike or tokenization errors? suggest threshold: >5% 5xx in a 5m window.
Sanjay: Also add GPU pool CPU/GPU-UTIL guard — if any node >90% for longer than 3m, hold and alert ops. I'll watch metrics. :rotating_light:
Carla: If we need to throttle, prefer backing off to 10% rather than full rollback unless it's clearly failing user-facing. Less noisy.
Noah: Rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if error rate >5% absolute above baseline OR 30% increase in p95 latency sustained for >10m. For transient 429s, auto-retry is ok but track trend.
Marta: sounds good. I'll update release notes and the deploy ticket. Will tag this thread when I trigger the toggle.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled toggle job queued: toggle_id=td-20260320-01, target=feature.model_serving_v2, window=2026-03-20T15:00Z-16:00Z, actor=Marta.
Marta: Running preflight checks now: smoke gen tests ✅, model checksum matches, canary weight ready.
Marta: /ffctl apply --feature model_serving_v2 --stages "2%,25%,100%" --hold "30m" --pin "legacy-pin"
Jin: Nice — also push a short eval set (10 prompts) to verify generation quality after 2% flip. If any regression we revert.
Sanjay: +1, set an alert in Grafana: alert_ff_spike -> channel #eng-oncall if 5xx > 5% in 5m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] toggle td-20260320-01: stage 1 (2%) applied at 2026-03-20T15:02:18Z. Monitoring: latency p95=210ms (baseline 200ms), errors=0.6%.
Jin: eval set looks clean so far. No hallucination uptick.
Marta: holding at 2% for 30m. Ops watching GPU util and request queue length.
Sanjay: saw a brief 429 blip at 15:10 but it resolved. No CPU pressure.
Carla: keeping the rollback plan ready but not triggered yet. :thumbsup:
Marta: increasing to 25% now — staging window opened early since metrics stable.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] toggle td-20260320-01: stage 2 (25%) applied at 2026-03-20T15:35:04Z. Monitoring: p95=220ms, errors=1.1%.
Noah: minor 429s and a few 503 traces in logs, but error rate under rollback threshold. Continue watch.
Jin: running a quick A/B diff on quality — no meaningful delta.
Marta: continuing to 100% at ~15:55 if no regressions. tagging release ticket #REL-1429 with notes.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] toggle td-20260320-01: stage 3 (100%) applied at 2026-03-20T16:02:03Z. Monitoring: p95=205ms, errors=0.9%.
Sanjay: GPU pool stable. No alerts triggered.
Carla: closing out — update the post-deploy checklist and schedule a 24h watch.
Marta: thanks team. Will unpin legacy after 48h if no regressions. :tada:
